Question ID: JOUR_U04_L03_GP_Q01

MLA Standard: MLA.JOUR.MED.03

Source: Headline: Join the Cafeteria Waste Challenge. Opening: Every lunch tray tells a story about our school choices. This month, the student newspaper invites every table to reduce wasted food and packaging. Body: Last week, cafeteria staff counted twelve full trash bags after one lunch period. The environmental club says many unopened milk cartons and packaged snacks were thrown away. The post asks students to take only what they plan to eat, place unopened items on the share table when allowed, and sort bottles into recycling bins. It ends with the line, Small daily choices can make our cafeteria cleaner, calmer, and more responsible. Sidebar: Three Ways to Help Today: take only what you need, use the share table correctly, and recycle bottles before leaving. Question 01: Which choice best explains the author purpose?

answer.text: A. The post exists only to entertain students with a story about lunch.

feedback.text: Not correct. Choice A says 'The post exists only to entertain students with a story about lunch.', which does not fully answer this specific journalism task. Recheck the source details, the question wording, and the mapped standard before choosing the best supported answer.

answer.text: B. The post persuades students to reduce cafeteria waste through practical lunch choices.

feedback.text: Correct. Step 1: identify the standard skill being tested. Step 2: use the embedded source and lesson model to justify the answer. This option is strongest because it connects purpose, rhetoric, language, claim, evidence, or validity to the source rather than guessing from topic alone.

answer.text: C. The post has no purpose because it is not a formal editorial.

feedback.text: Not correct. Choice C says 'The post has no purpose because it is not a formal editorial.', which does not fully answer this specific journalism task. Recheck the source details, the question wording, and the mapped standard before choosing the best supported answer.

answer.text: D. The purpose is to describe every cafeteria rule in the school handbook.

feedback.text: Not correct. Choice D says 'The purpose is to describe every cafeteria rule in the school handbook.', which does not fully answer this specific journalism task. Recheck the source details, the question wording, and the mapped standard before choosing the best supported answer.
